whyItMatters: HTTP Basic credentials in a Proxy-Authorization header copies cleanly into bug reports, fixtures and client bundles, so revocation rather than deletion is what ends the exposure.
actions: Revoke the credential at the service that issued it.
Load the header value at run time from a secret manager.
Search fixtures, bundles and logs for the same value and purge them.
verification: The revoked value is rejected and no literal of this header remains in the tree.
